name: Natsu o Shizuka ni
source:
It is a long pale friendship story with a comedy touch and BL entourage that happens during this quiet summer.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这个宁静的夏天，展开了一段悠长而淡淡的友情故事，其中带着喜剧色彩与男生之间的暧昧气息。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
